questions.context_sentence: We use I'll when we've just decided to do something.
questions.cn: 当我们刚刚决定要做某事时，我们用I'll。
questions.hint: di（弟）+ cide（切开）：弟弟下定决心把苹果切开。
questions.prompt: We use I'll when we've just ____ to do something. (提示: 决定)

questions.context_sentence: When we say 'I'll do something', we announce our decision.
questions.cn: 当我们说“我会做某事”时，我们宣布了我们的决定。
questions.hint: an（一个）+ ounce（盎司）：大声宣布得了一盎司黄金。

questions.context_sentence: Did you call Max? Oh no, I forgot.
questions.cn: 你给马克斯打电话了吗？哦，不，我忘了。
questions.hint: for（为了）+ get（得到）：为了得到新东西，却把旧的给忘了。

questions.context_sentence: I'm a little hungry.
questions.cn: 我有点饿了。
questions.hint: hun（洪）+ gry（干力气活）：洪金宝干完活肚子饿了。

questions.context_sentence: That bag looks heavy.
questions.cn: 那个包看起来很重。
questions.hint: hea（黑）+ vy（威力）：黑金刚力气大，搬得动重的箱子。

questions.context_sentence: Thanks for lending me the money.
questions.cn: 谢谢你借给我钱。
questions.hint: l + end（结尾）：借钱有期限，到了结尾要还。

questions.context_sentence: I won't tell anyone what happened. I promise.
questions.cn: 我不会告诉任何人发生了什么。我保证。
questions.hint: pro（向前）+ mise（米老鼠）：米老鼠向前保证一定守信用。
questions.prompt: I won't tell anyone what happened. I ____. (提示: 承诺，保证)

questions.context_sentence: We use won't to say that somebody refuses to do something.
questions.cn: 我们用won't来表示某人拒绝做某事。
questions.hint: re（重新）+ fuse（熔断）：电路拒绝通电，直接熔断了。

questions.context_sentence: I'm going on holiday next Saturday.
questions.cn: 我打算下周六去度假。
questions.hint: hol（好）+ i + day（天）：好开心的一天，放假了。

questions.context_sentence: We use shall I ...? / shall we ...? to ask if it's OK to do something or to ask for a suggestion.
questions.cn: 我们用shall I ...? / shall we ...?来询问做某事是否可以或征求建议。
questions.hint: sug（死个）+ ges（鸽子）+ tion（名词后缀）：提出建议把鸽子放飞。
questions.prompt: We use shall I ...? / shall we ...? to ask if it's OK to do something or to ask for a ____.
